rows.label: qst711501_msg0002
rows.name:
I'm an adventurer studying the link
between ether and Divine Beasts, yes.

rows.label: qst711501_msg0003
rows.name:
Are you familiar with the black,
stream-like phenomenon known as
ether miasma?

rows.label: qst711501_msg0004
rows.name:
A small ether miasma has recently
been detected here in Gula, yes.

rows.label: qst711501_msg0005
rows.name:
I also headed to the site for
investigation, but on the way,
I was chased by monsters...

rows.label: qst711501_msg0006
rows.name:
As an adventurer who specializes in
brainwork, I had no way to deal with
the monsters, yes.

rows.label: qst711501_msg0007
rows.name: So I wanted to ask you a favor...

rows.label: qst711501_msg0008
rows.name:
I'd like you to defeat the Espina
Feris that is bothering me.

rows.label: qst711501_msg0009
rows.name:
Then I can devote myself to studying
ether miasma, yes.
